decision: One coherent three-file production browser proof PR fits the default 500-line cap. The helper and all four new scenarios can land together. Do not add unnecessary intermediate PRs solely because the initial proposal split them.
selectorScope: The explicit-tab browser scenario already merged in PR1637. Only the Armor tonnage selector remains local (3additions/1deletion); establish its ambiguity on the isolated full suite before admitting the bounded locator repair. PR1639 contains no e2e files.
acceptance: Fresh E2E-enabled production build/hydration; full declared twelve-case Chromium customizer surface with zero retries, real print-popup capture, popup/canvas failure recovery, PDF geometry and Infantry mobile/zoom. OS print dialog and other browser engines remain outside this proof.
